messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: control-plane error spike observed for api.redwood.com — elevated 5xx rates (502/504/timeouts) across auth/org-lookup and config backends. Paging #oncall (priority: P1).
Alex: saw the Pager. 502s from gateway started ~10:12 UTC, spike to ~18% errors for a 5m window. graphs: https://dash.internal/redwood/ctrlplane/errors — can someone pick this up?
Oncall-SRE: I'm on it, grabbing pager. Starting triage now. tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform.
Maya: i'm looking at the auth proxy logs — a lot of upstream timeouts to org-lookup (10s+). Also seeing 429s and some connection resets. Could be cascading timeouts.
Priya: Greg from config rolled a small feature flag update ~09:58 UTC, but rate of errors didn't jump until ~10:10. worth checking config-db pool saturation.
Jon: checking control-plane service metrics: org-lookup latency P90 jumped from 60ms -> 5.2s. Redis connections for org cache show spikes in wait queue.
Emily: Product reports a customer-facing issue — web UI show "Something went wrong" for some users, CS tickets coming in. Estimated 15% of requests failing for enterprise customers in US-W.
Oncall-SRE: immediate mitigation plan: 1) set auth proxy circuit-breaker to fail-fast for org-lookup 2) roll config flag back if we see config service errors 3) enable degraded-mode cache serve for org lookups. Priya, can you coordinate rollback?
Priya: on it. rolling back flag now: `kubectl -n controlplane set env deploy/config-service FEATURE_X=false` — watching rollout.
Maya: temporary CB change applied on auth-proxy: `circuit_breaker: open_after: 5s` — will return 502s quicker but avoid long head-of-line waits.
Alex: adding rate-limit at edge for heavy customers to reduce burst to control plane: `x-rate-limit: 50/s` applied to gateway for org-lookup routes.
Jon: config service replicas scaled from 3 -> 6 to relieve DB pool contention. `kubectl scale deploy/config-service --replicas=6` — observing improved CPU and connection pool.
IncidentBot: Event: config-service rollout complete (10:22:34 UTC).
Priya: rollback completed, config-service responses now within 150ms for most requests. org-lookup latency improving but still some 500s from auth proxy.
Maya: looked into auth-proxy heap and threads — saw threadpools saturated when redis wait_time > 200ms. applying change to async worker pool to 50 -> 100. live patching now.
Oncall-SRE: we should cut an immediate fallback: enable cached org data for 5m TTL in auth path. Doing that now (feature toggle `auth.use_stale_cache=true`).
Emily: CS update: told customers we have partial degradation, engineering working on mitigation. Escalating to Account Execs for top 5 customers.
Alex: preliminary customer impact: ~10-20% error rate for control-plane calls for 10-20 minutes; critical user flows (login, quota checks) affected for some accounts. Not seeing data exfil or billing impact yet.
Priya: after scaling and rollback, error rate down to ~3% and continuing to trend down.
Jon: root cause hypothesis: recent config flag change increased read-on-write pattern to config DB triggering connection pool exhaustion, which cascaded to org-cache and then auth proxy due to blocking calls. Also thundering cache misses on org lookup. Need postmortem to validate.
Maya: opened a temporary alert rule to detect org-lookup P95 > 1s earlier than before.
Oncall-SRE: handing off to SRE rotation for deeper post-incident work. I'll create a follow-up ticket and add owners.
Oncall-SRE: paging handoff to Priya (weekday-night SRE). Handoff notes: rollback done, auth CB open, caching toggles on, scale applied. watch for error rate <1% for next 30m before close.
Priya: acknowledged handoff. I will run a canary sweep and confirm no regression.
Emily: request to ops: prepare an incident timeline and a short customer-facing blurb for AE — I'll draft and send to legal for ok.
Alex: +1 on timeline. Please include exact impacted window and mitigations taken.
Priya: can confirm at 10:40 UTC we were stable at ~0.6% errors. Will start RCA doc and include perf traces and DB connection metrics.
Jon: logging note: captured a stacktrace NPE in a fallback path that may have worsened crash-looping under load — adding to RCA items.
IncidentBot: Pager resolved (auto): error rates returned to baseline.
Maya: reassigning follow-ups: 1) postmortem (Priya) 2) config DB pool tuning (Jon) 3) org-cache hit-rate improvements and cache warming (Maya) 4) graceful fallback docs for auth-proxy (Alex).
Emily: customer comms draft in #customer-updates, tagging AE leads.
Priya: marking this thread for SEV follow-up. Will ping owners in 30m if any regression.
Alex: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
